positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.desc: Own SilentHelp's technical vision — the on-device detection engine, the macOS agent, and the path from prototype to product.
resp: Set the technical roadmap from Flask prototype to native macOS product
Own the 4-layer detection architecture (keyword → semantic → behavioral → trend)
Make the on-device privacy guarantee real in every technical decision
Recruit and lead the engineering team
pref: Has built and shipped a real product

positions.title: Lead AI Engineer
positions.desc: Make the semantic layer smart enough to catch what keywords miss — and small enough to run fully on-device.
resp: Own Layer 2 (semantic classification) and its move from cloud NIM to a local model
Tune precision so alerts fire when they matter and never when they don't
Design evaluation sets for crisis-language detection
Keep every inference on-device in production

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.desc: Build the product surface — dashboard, coping chat, analytics — on a backend that never sees user text.
resp: Ship features across the Flask backend and web app
Own the API contract (/classify, /api/chat, /api/behavioral…)
Build the analytics and findings views
Keep the data model strictly on-device

positions.title: UI/UX Designer
positions.desc: Design calm. SilentHelp appears at someone's worst moment — every screen has to feel like a hand on the shoulder, not an alarm.
resp: Own the design language (Playfair + Inter, light product UI)
Design the escalation and popup flows with care
Prototype in Figma or claude.ai/design
Run the design system as the team grows
pref: Interest in crisis UX / calm technology

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.desc: Decide what we build next and why — balancing student needs, school requirements, and a hard privacy line.
resp: Own the roadmap from prototype to school beta
Talk to students, counselors, and administrators
Write specs the team can build from
Define success metrics that respect privacy

positions.title: Privacy & Compliance Director
positions.desc: Our whole promise is that data never leaves the device. Prove it, document it, and keep us honest as we enter schools.
resp: Own the privacy architecture review
Handle COPPA / FERPA questions for school deployments
Write the plain-language privacy policy
Audit every feature before it ships
pref: Background in ed-tech or health-tech compliance

positions.title: Community Partnerships Lead
positions.desc: Get SilentHelp into the hands of schools, counselors, and community programs — starting with our own city.
resp: Build relationships with schools and counselors
Run the pilot-program pipeline
Represent SilentHelp at community events
Collect feedback loops from partners

positions.title: Marketing Director
positions.desc: Tell the story of technology that notices — without ever exploiting the pain it exists to catch.
resp: Own brand voice and the public site
Launch content for the school beta
Handle press and social presence
Keep marketing as ethical as the product
pref: Portfolio of real campaigns, any size
